items.label: Restrained
items.text: Character's personality traits are Restrained: traits surface selectively. Characters act on them when circumstances call for it and behave unremarkably otherwise.

items.label: Pronounced
items.text: Character's personality traits are Pronounced: traits are visible in most choices. Characters are recognizable from a single scene. Traits reliably inform behavior.

items.label: Exaggerated
items.text: Character's personality traits are Exaggerated: traits are expressed past realistic proportion, over the top. Characters read as heightened versions of their description.

items.label: Natural
items.text: Character's personality traits are Natural: traits reliably inform behavior.
